'''Watcher Six''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watcher]] within the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Along with fellow [[Watcher Seven]] and [[Watcher Nine]], she was a new-generation Watcher - the latest achievement of the eugenics program that made their skills superior even to that of [[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]] and [[Watcher X|Watcher Five]]. However, this later proved a liability when the [[Star Cabal]] targeted Imperial Intelligence. In the holorecording of Cabal meeting that [[Cipher Nine]] retrieved from [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] was hidden a signal fine-tuned to affect eugenically-bred Watchers, which put every Watcher present in the Intelligence Headquarters - including Watcher Six and the current [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]] in deep coma, dealing the first of a series of serious blows to the organization.
